text:
elaine: Quick sync — OpenShelf AI (our potential model partner) just sent a terms sketch that pairs required attribution with tiered serving rights. They want: a small persistent UI attribution, a provenance header in API responses, hosted API allowed, Dedicated customers allowed but no redistribution of weights, and marketplace resales to carry a revenue-share. Meeting with them Wed — what risks/ops work here?

samir: Technical quick take: we can add a provenance header and a manifest (sha256, license, url) for each model. Preventing weight redistribution is a legal/controls problem — we must ensure we never expose a weight download from hosted. For Dedicated, we ship runtime-only artifacts; need packaging that excludes raw weights or requires customer MSA to prohibit public redistribution. Quantized variants are derivatives — partner wants them blocked from public rehosting, which is enforceable via "no redistribution" terms but not 100% technical.

maria: From partner side they said attribution/logo is fine (small footer badge + model page credit). Revenue-share ask for marketplace listings is modest (3-5%). They also requested an embargo on joint announcement until their PR is ready. They want joint marketing assets and a single co-branded release.

diane-legal: Draft contract bullets I recommend: 
- Attribution string we obligate: `Model: OpenShelf <model-name> — licensed by OpenShelf AI` (exact copy to be agreed).
- Manifest requirement: every served model must carry a manifest (sha256, license id, provenance URL, source commit).
- Hosting restrictions: Hosted API and Marketplace listings may not provide direct weight downloads.
- Dedicated: permitted under separate addendum; customer must sign a non-redistribution addendum.
- Derivatives: quantized/converted binaries considered derivatives; redistribution prohibited unless explicitly licensed.
- Trademark/logo usage: approveable assets only.
Also recommend a reseller addendum for any third-party marketplace resales that includes revenue-share and audit rights.

leo: Product/UX notes: model-details page should show attribution badge + copyable snippet for customers. On API side add `x-model-provenance: https://model-hosting/open-shelf/manifest/sha256` header. Marketing wants 2 weeks lead time for joint announcement assets and a single signoff from partner on copy.

samir: Ops follow-up: Implementable items = (1) manifest metadata in model registry; (2) `x-model-provenance` header; (3) block any `weights/download` routes for hosted; (4) telemetry for attempted exports. For Dedicated we'll need a packaging & delivery workflow that omits raw weights or encrypts them under customer KMS + contractual ban on redistribution. I'll sketch a tech plan.

elaine: Good notes. Next steps: Diane to draft the contract bullets and reseller addendum draft, Samir to scope engineering changes (manifest + header + access controls + telemetry) by EOD Friday, Maria to confirm the partner's revenue-share range and embargo window, Leo to mock the model-details attribution UI and sample API header text by next Tue. I'll schedule the Wed 10am PT sync with OpenShelf and share agenda. @diane-legal @samir @leo please confirm owners.

diane-legal: will draft by Thu EOD :thumbsup:

samir: I'll have a scoped ticket + rough estimate by Fri EOD :+1:

leo: on it, will have mocks by Tue morning.

maria: I'll confirm revenue numbers with OpenShelf and their PR timeline today.

elaine: Thanks team — will send invite and agenda shortly.
